verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers digital tools through LathamDrive, including a document generator and an Automated Convertible Note generator, so a machine-readable API spec is a plausible thing to ask about. However, no evidence shows it publishes one, and probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
